verdict.rationale: Relay's docs say it can capture receipts, categorize expenses in real time, and automatically sync to accounting software, alongside real-time card transaction tracking and detailed QuickBooks/Xero sync. That covers the coding and sync side of the story. However, nothing shows receipts being captured automatically at the moment of card use without the user supplying them, and the claims are marketing-level only. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic receipt capture triggered by a card swipe (e.g. SMS/email receipt matching), documentation of how auto-categorization or coding rules work, independent or hands-on corroboration.
